name: MPB Song Sections A3 — Althea (2013 Remaster), Dance Hall Days
description: A-grade songs split into their sections so each part can be played on its own: Althea (2013 Remaster), Dance Hall Days. For each song there is one row that plays the whole song by calling its section rows in order, then one row per section named with its number and its section name (Intro, Verse1, Chorus2_a …). Every row starts m10 and the song's tempo (for example 94T), so playing a row sets the bank tempo to that song. Section names marked "(a guess)" in the note are low-confidence. Grades compare each row with the hits detected in the drum stem.
prompt: make some MPL Bank JSON files with the drums parts into sections with corresponding MPL so I can play each one at a time - maybe a handful of A-list songs could fill a MPL Bank
